label: List members
description: List every member weft holds anything for in this project: saved values, connections, infra copies, member tokens, trigger activations. One entry per member with what they have (counts and states, never a value or a secret), including fires of their triggers that wait because they have not filled a field yet, with the reason. For an admin overview, or a website that shows a member what is missing.

outputs.name: members
outputs.description: One entry per member: `{ member, values, connections, tokens, copies, triggers }`. `values`, `connections` and `tokens` are counts (tokens that still work); `copies` is their infra copies, each `{ node, member, status, failure? }`; `triggers` is their trigger activations, each `{ trigger, mode, waiting? }`, where `waiting` is `{ fires, reason }` when fires wait on a value they have not given (`reason` names the field).

outputs.name: ids
outputs.description: Every member's id, in the same order.

outputs.name: waiting
outputs.description: The members with fires waiting on a value they have not given.
